messages.subject: [R-GSoC] Mentor final evaluations close tomorrow!
parts:

completed.

Google's deadlines are firm, and we don't have the ability to grant
extra time.

As always, please reach out to Toby or me ASAP if you have any
quewstions, concerns, or problems.
